claims.statement: The proposed paid event is a portability subscription and the hypothesised loss is reconstruction time, duplication, or missing context; consumer willingness to pay is not evidenced.
Individuals and voluntary employer-benefit programs are hypothesised payers, but no Polish price test, benefit budget, or signed distribution partner exists.
The control path is explicit user mandate plus replaceable source integrations and portable exports; the founder currently controls no health-data source or subscriber relationship.

EHDS is designed to strengthen individual access, control, and sharing of electronic health data, while the Data Act addresses user access to connected-product data; implementation timing and source-specific interfaces remain material unknowns.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: Consumer household budget, people-benefits lead, or broker administering a voluntary benefit
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Remain source-neutral, emphasize verifiable provenance and consent history, support cross-platform exit, and avoid monetizing health data
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: Unknown until a direct subscriber relationship is acquired; channel partners retain their own relationships
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Clinic, laboratory, benefits, coach, and quantified-self partner referrals

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Partner share or content/community acquisition; target below six months of gross profit
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Subscription collected in advance; annual plans improve runway but increase refund and trust obligations
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Unvalidated target 65-80% after storage, connectors, parsing, support, and partner share
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Self-serve onboarding with exception queues for failed imports, identity mismatches, and schema ambiguity
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Privacy and health-data counsel, security testing, incident response, cyber insurance, vendor audits, and support governance
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Hypothesis: 29-69 PLN per consumer per month or 12-30 PLN per eligible employee per month
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Connector calls, storage, encryption and key operations, document parsing, support, payment fees, and breach-risk cover

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Mobile operating systems, EHR vendors, national health portals, wearable platforms, and insurers can bundle record aggregation and export
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Paid event is a monthly or annual portability subscription; measurable loss is time, duplicated testing, or lost context when a user cannot assemble a complete, provenance-linked record
commercial_mechanics.payer: Individual subscriber or employer benefits program
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: Provider switch, international move, new wearable or lab, chronic-care handoff, family-care coordination, or AI-coach onboarding
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Continued connector synchronization, provenance monitoring, new-source ingestion, and export availability

contrary_evidence: Users may expect portability from national health portals, EHR providers, or mobile operating systems at no extra cost.
A vault without diagnostic advice may feel less valuable than an integrated care or coaching product.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Proposed user data-rights mandate and processing agreement, supplemented by nonexclusive API or workflow integrations where available
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Accept standards-based or human-readable user exports, support local-only storage, or omit the source with an explicit completeness warning
critical_control_point.current_owner: The individual controls applicable rights while providers and device platforms control source systems and interfaces
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: Unknown until a direct subscriber relationship is acquired; channel partners retain their own relationships
critical_control_point.duration: Subscription duration plus lawful retention and user-directed deletion periods
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: Personal interest in quantified self and data science does not create user, clinic, laboratory, wearable-platform, or health-record access rights.
critical_control_point.launch_controller: Each user and every source platform or provider needed for automated access
critical_control_point.renewal: Monthly or annual user renewal with per-connector reauthorisation as required
critical_control_point.subject: User-authorized workflow for importing, normalizing, recording provenance, and exporting personal health and wellness data

economics.acquisition_route: Referrals from private clinics, labs, benefits brokers, coaches, and quantified-self communities
economics.founder_net_worth_path: A trusted cross-source subscription could scale internationally or sell to a benefits or health-platform buyer; 5m PLN likely requires tens of thousands of retained subscribers over 4-7 years
economics.founder_time: Up to five hours per day with self-service onboarding, automated normalization, and strict exception queues
economics.gross_margin_basis: Subscription less storage, security, connector, parsing, payment, support, insurance, and channel cost
economics.payback: Target below six months of gross profit per acquired subscriber; not evidenced
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 29-69 PLN per consumer per month or 12-30 PLN per eligible employee per month
economics.retention_or_repeat: Monthly or annual while synchronized provenance and portable exports remain valuable

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Connector coverage, schema mappings, provenance rules, and user-corrected normalization improve while underlying health rights remain with each user
fingerprint.customer: Privacy-conscious quantified-self users, mobile professionals, and families managing fragmented health records
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Partner with private clinics, labs, benefits brokers, coaches, and wearable communities at an onboarding or provider-switch event
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Encrypted personal vault, connector library, normalization, consent ledger, change detection, and one-click evidence exports
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Individual or employer benefit plan pays a recurring subscription for maintained portability, provenance, and export readiness
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A user changes provider, device, country, coach, or health application and must reconstruct a trusted longitudinal record

founder_fit: Direct match to quantified-self interest, data engineering, provenance, and AI-assisted normalization
Software subscription delivery is measurable, automatable, and compatible with limited daily hours
A local-first narrow-source pilot can stay well below 100k PLN
The product can scale across markets without constant founder visibility if trust and channels are earned
risks: A breach or account takeover would expose highly sensitive data
Platform API changes can break automated imports
Normalization errors could mislead users or downstream clinicians even without explicit advice
Large ecosystem owners can bundle the core features and underprice a standalone service

structural_signature.commercial_model_descriptor: monthly personal data portability provenance and export readiness subscription
structural_signature.control_point_descriptor: recurring user authorized import normalization consent and export layer
structural_signature.critical_dependency_descriptor: clinical laboratory and wearable interfaces or reliable user export formats

structure.control_point: the user's recurring import, normalization, consent, and export workflow
structure.critical_dependency: stable interfaces or lawful user exports from clinical, lab, and wearable data providers

thesis: Future operating state (2031): individuals routinely delegate record retrieval, longitudinal tracking, and administrative preparation to personal health agents while keeping authority over their data. Missing data and coordination mechanism: a user-controlled vault that normalizes clinical exports, labs, wearables, consent receipts, provenance, and revocations into a portable evidence bundle without making diagnostic or treatment claims.
title: Personal Health Portability Vault
uncertainties: Consumer willingness to pay for portability before an urgent switching event
Available Polish clinical, laboratory, and wearable export or API formats
Whether employer distribution creates additional health-data and discrimination risk
Support burden from low-quality PDFs, duplicates, identity matching, and multilingual records
